title: FBI Photo B017
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: grayscale surveillance or targeting display with crosshair overlay
pages.description: A noisy gray monochrome image resembling a sensor or tracking display. A white crosshair overlay is centered, with a vertical line and a horizontal line meeting near the middle of the frame; the horizontal arm has short tick marks at each end, each labeled with the numeral '3'. Near the center, slightly below the crossing point, are two small dark spots that appear to be a tracked object or target. Several solid black redaction bars obscure portions of the image: one large bar across the top, and pairs of rectangular bars on the left and right sides at three vertical levels. A timestamp reading '12/31/99 18:20:48' appears in white text at the bottom-left corner. The background has a grainy, static-like texture.
